people.Sabhanara: Eldest of Anu's three sons, with Chakshu and Pareshnu. SB 9.23.1

JanamejayaA.name: Janamejaya
JanamejayaA.note: Son of Srinjaya of the Anu line. SB 9.23.2

people.Mahamana: Two sons, Ushinara and Titikshu, and from them the two great Anu branches: Madra and Kekaya on one side, Anga and Karna's throne on the other. SB 9.23.2
people.Ushinara: King of the Bhojas. One of the four to whom Yayati's daughter Madhavi was lent, and by her the father of Shibi. SB 9.23.2-3; MBh 5.114
people.Titikshu: Brother of Ushinara; the Anga line descends from him. SB 9.23.2-4
people.Shibi: Son of Ushinara by Madhavi. A hawk claimed a dove that had taken refuge with him, and rather than give up the one who trusted him he cut flesh from his own body to pay the weight. Four sons: Vrishadarbha, Sudhira, Madra and Kekaya. SB 9.23.3; MBh 3.131, 5.114

DakshaU.name: Daksha
DakshaU.note: Son of Ushinara. Not Daksha the Prajapati. SB 9.23.3

unions.note: The third of Madhavi's four. MBh 5.114
